item.title: Safety in Zig: Spatial Memory Safety
item.description:
Zig provides spatial memory safety. It can perform bounds checking at compile time, for comptime known values, and crash with appropriate stack trace for runtime values. This means it prevents out-of-bounds access to arrays etc.

We’ll take a look at 2 simple examples to see how this works in practice.

item.title: Safety in Zig: How Debug Allocator Works
item.description: Zig is not a memory-safe language. It, however, provides some tools to help avoid some memory safety issues. One of the key tools that help achieve this is the debug allocator.
